<section id="commands">
<h1>Commands</h1>
<p>WikiMason uses a neutral command vocabulary across all profiles. There
is no profile-specific command set.</p>
<section id="command-families">
<h2>Command families</h2>
<table class="docutils align-default">
<thead>
<tr class="row-odd"><th class="head"><p>Group</p></th>
<th class="head"><p>Purpose</p></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">init</span></code></p></td>
<td><p>Initialize a new wiki vault.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">config</span></code></p></td>
<td><p>Show, edit, and validate TOML configuration.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">log</span></code></p></td>
<td><p>Append, inspect, and validate the operational timeline in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Wiki/log.md</span></code>.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source</span></code></p></td>
<td><p>Import, scan, verify, resolve, read, rehash, and lint raw sources.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ingest</span></code></p></td>
<td><p>Plan and finish raw-source-to-note workflows.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">note</span></code></p></td>
<td><p>Create, validate, and normalize semantic notes.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">page</span></code></p></td>
<td><p>Create, show, update, move, and delete profile-neutral pages.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">links</span></code></p></td>
<td><p>Resolve, check, normalize, and inventory internal links.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">file</span></code></p></td>
<td><p>Safe vault-relative file and folder operations.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">daily</span></code></p></td>
<td><p>Daily notes and Markdown metadata utilities.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">catalog</span></code></p></td>
<td><p>Build generated catalog, index pages, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">AGENTS.md</span></code>.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">doctor</span></code></p></td>
<td><p>Health, validation, and audit commands.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">context</span></code></p></td>
<td><p>Select, plan, and export wiki context for LLM chat or search.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">vault</span></code></p></td>
<td><p>Vault initialization, registry, build, lint, doctor, and maintenance.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">skill</span></code></p></td>
<td><p>Locate or install the packaged WikiMason agent skill.</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</section>
<section id="example-workflows">
<h2>Example workflows</h2>
<p>Initialize a vault:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>wikimason<span class="w"> </span>init<span class="w"> </span>markdown<span class="w"> </span>.
wikimason<span class="w"> </span>init<span class="w"> </span>obsidian<span class="w"> </span>~/Documents/MyVault
wikimason<span class="w"> </span>init<span class="w"> </span>logseq<span class="w"> </span>~/Documents/Logseq/MyGraph
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Source lifecycle:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>wikimason<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">source</span><span class="w"> </span>scan<span class="w"> </span>--update<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>json
wikimason<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">source</span><span class="w"> </span>delta<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>json
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Create compiled pages:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>wikimason<span class="w"> </span>note<span class="w"> </span>new<span class="w"> </span>--kind<span class="w"> </span>topic<span class="w"> </span>--title<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Compiled Knowledge&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--source<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Raw/Sources/report.md&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span>--allow-incomplete<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>json
wikimason<span class="w"> </span>page<span class="w"> </span>update<span class="w"> </span>Wiki/Concepts/retrieval-pipeline.md<span class="w"> </span>--body-file<span class="w"> </span>/tmp/body.md<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>json
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Validate and finish:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>wikimason<span class="w"> </span>links<span class="w"> </span>check<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>json
wikimason<span class="w"> </span>ingest<span class="w"> </span>finish<span class="w"> </span>--accept-covered<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>json
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Maintain:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>wikimason<span class="w"> </span>vault<span class="w"> </span>maintain<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>json
wikimason<span class="w"> </span>log<span class="w"> </span>tail<span class="w"> </span>-n<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">5</span><span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>json
wikimason<span class="w"> </span>log<span class="w"> </span>check<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>json
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Context export for LLM chat:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>wikimason<span class="w"> </span>context<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;retrieval pipeline&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>json
wikimason<span class="w"> </span>context<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;retrieval pipeline&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span>--print<span class="w"> </span>--source-closure
wikimason<span class="w"> </span>context<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">export</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;retrieval pipeline&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span>-o<span class="w"> </span>context.md<span class="w"> </span>--purpose<span class="w"> </span>chat
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>For the full command reference with every flag and usage string, see
<a class="reference internal" href="../command-reference/"><span class="std std-doc">Command Reference</span></a>.</p>
